library(dplyr) 
library(ggplot2) 
library(stringr) 
library(tm) 

#### Read the data 

#file_path <- "C:/Desktop/DATA 104 R Programming/positivewords.txt" 

file_path <- "C:/Desktop/DATA 104 R Programming/negativewords.txt" 

positive_words <- readLines(file_path) 

# Printing the content 
print(positive_words) 

rm(list = ls())
sessionInfo() 
sample(positive_words, 30) 
head(positive_words,10) 
cleaned_text = gsub(pattern = "\\W", replace = " ", positive_words) 
print(cleaned_text) 
cleaned_text = gsub(pattern = "\\d", replace = " ",cleaned_text) 
cleaned_text = gsub(pattern = "\\d", replace = " ",cleaned_text) 
cleaned_text = removeWords(cleaned_text, stopwords("english")) 
cleaned_text = tolower(cleaned_text) 

## to remove lenth of 1  
cleaned_text = gsub(pattern = "\\b[A-z]\\b{1}", replace = " ", cleaned_text) 

#to strip white spaces 
cleaned_text = stripWhitespace(cleaned_text) 
text_bag = str_split(cleaned_text, pattern = "\\s") 
text_bag = unlist(text_bag) 
print(text_bag) 
wordcloud(text_bag, min.freq = 2, max.words=Inf,col = rainbow(10), random.order = FALSE) 

#  Frequency Analysis 
word_freq <- table(text_bag) 
word_freq_df <- as.data.frame(word_freq) 
word_freq_df <- word_freq_df %>% arrange(desc(Freq))
